description: Due diligence on a US-listed company beyond the last numbers, all from its SEC filings: the trend over eight quarters (revenue growth against the same quarter a year before, gross, operating and net margins, inventory or receivables outgrowing sales, free cash flow against earnings), valuation (market cap, P/E, P/S from its Robinhood stock token price, when it has one), management's outlook quoted from the latest earnings release, the 8-Ks of the last 120 days (CEO changes, auditor changes, restatements, layoffs), dated catalysts ahead (the next earnings date estimated from last year's, debt coming due, buyback left, shelf expiry, annual meeting), and what to watch (risk factors added in the latest 10-K, customer concentration, going-concern language). Each item links to its filing. Use for 'do DD on X', 'what are the catalysts for X', 'what should I watch on X'. Premium: 10¢ a call from prepaid agent credits (3 free premium calls a day). Send your agent key as Authorization: Bearer <key>.
